description: This file provides utility functions related to date manipulation and formatting, including getting the start and end of a month, generating keys and labels for months, formatting dates in ISO standards, and parsing ISO date strings.

methods.name: monthStart
methods.description: Returns a DateTime representing the first day of the month for the given date.

methods.name: monthEnd
methods.description: Returns a DateTime representing the last day of the month for the given date.

methods.name: monthKey
methods.description: Returns a string formatted as 'yyyy-MM' for the given date, useful as a unique month identifier.

methods.name: monthLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for the month, formatted as 'MMMM yyyy'.

methods.name: dateIso
methods.description: Returns the date formatted as an ISO string 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

methods.name: parseIsoDate
methods.description: Parses an ISO date string into a DateTime object.
